briefdescription.para: This file defines the SparseMultiSet class, which adds multiset behavior to the SparseSet.

detaileddescription.para: A sparse multiset holds a small number of objects identified by integer keys from a moderately sized universe. The sparse multiset uses more memory than other containers in order to provide faster operations. Any key can map to multiple values. A SparseMultiSetNode class is provided, which serves as a convenient base class for the contents of a SparseMultiSet.
